# Summarize diagnostics

<small>Source: [`man/summary.HeteroDiagnostic.Rd`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/man/summary.HeteroDiagnostic.Rd) · Help: `?summary.HeteroDiagnostic`</small>

Summarize diagnostic test results.

## Usage

```r
## S3 method for class 'HeteroDiagnostic'
summary(object, tests = c("white", "koenker"), ...)
```

## Arguments

`object`
:   A `HeteroDiagnostic` object.

`tests`
:   Character vector naming the diagnostics to summarise. Defaults to the White and Koenker tests, the
    default of [`runHeteroTests`](runHeteroTests.md); it was the White and the classical Breusch-Pagan tests up to 0.14.0.

`...`
:   Further arguments passed to the individual tests.

## Value

Named numeric vector of test statistics.
